estate_context_packet_summary: Small deterministic packet includes validation/readiness, assignment queue, Alfred surface, Engineering/CueMastery handoff, pending package names, and recent active history.

example_mode_prompt_and_response.prompt: Alfred, are you running from JSON files or an LLM right now?
example_mode_prompt_and_response.response: Pat, this answer is being generated through local_llm with provider ollama and model qwen3:8b; JSON artifacts provide context, not the whole response.

example_role_prompt_and_response.prompt: Good afternoon Alfred, define your role for me.
example_role_prompt_and_response.response: Pat, my role is Alfred of the Office of Operations: I coordinate local Estate status, recommendations, and proposed next actions without executing privileged work.

fallback_behavior: Fallback remains deterministic and records provider/model/endpoint/fallback_reason when local Ollama is unavailable or fails.
known_limitations: Codex cannot reach local Ollama; final true local_llm smoke check must be run on the Steward Windows machine with Ollama running.
local_llm_adapter_provider_changes: Added LocalOllamaAdapter with /api/tags and ollama list discovery plus /api/generate invocation.
prompt_construction_summary: Resident-aware Alfred prompt includes role/office, Steward identity, API/version/capabilities, authority status, local-first non-execution policy, bounded context, recent history, and current message.
pull_request_not_applicable_reason: make_pr tool is called after git commit per Codex workflow; no external PR URL exists before that tool call.
pull_request_url_or_not_applicable_reaso: PR metadata will be recorded by make_pr after commit in this non-interactive Codex workflow.
recommended_next_action: Run Steward local smoke checks and verify mode local_llm/provider ollama/model qwen3:8b in the UI/API.
selected_alfred_model_policy: Prefer qwen3:8b for Alfred; otherwise first discovered local model.
